lines.text: Lugia 078/124 #78/124 (Deck Exclusives): $47.11 (Nov 7) to $86.80 (Nov 14) on TCGplayer market. Up 84%.

Down 27% in a week: Pikachu (30th Celebration) 58/102 went from $17.47 on Nov 7 to $12.83 on Nov 14. ME: 30th Celebration came out Sep 16, Modern era, still Standard legal, its 191 priced cards add up to $12,828.11.

Down 20% in a week: M Rayquaza EX (Celebrations) 76/108 went from $30.59 on Nov 7 to $24.55 on Nov 14. It has closed lower 7 weeks running, from $38.45 on Sep 26. It is still 61% under its peak of $63.34 on Oct 2, 2025.
EX Emerald, about 30 days: 7 of 29 priced cards up 10% or more, 0 down 10% or more. Start prices Oct 15, end Nov 14, TCGplayer market.
